name: aif-ext-memlab
description: Project memory for AI Factory via memlab: registers the memlab MCP server and lets /aif-warmup, /aif-explore, /aif-plan and /aif-fix ask it for past decisions and the code a change touches. Optional by construction: without memlab every skill behaves as before.

mcpServers.instruction: memlab: install it first — pip install git+https://github.com/sattva2020/memlab (Python 3.11+). If you already use the memlab Claude Code plugin, remove this server entry so only one memlab server starts.
